items.text: Until hv says go (vc relays it): spike 2 for ST0026 outcome D, which moves a window the way a person does, is written and tested here but not run on the machine. Files in /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-matts-Devel-prj-Utilz/b6f789ca-4627-4a74-b4cd-bb7c07de9f46/scratchpad/arngz-spike/: arngz-spike2.lua (the verbs), run-hs.sh (runs one verb through hs, polls for its result file, kills hs), RUNBOOK-2.md (commands, what each step costs hv, what success looks like, every refusal by name), test/spike2_test.lua (290 checks pass against a simulated hs) and test/run-hs_test.sh (22 pass). Spike 1's arngz-spike.lua and RUNBOOK.md sit beside them. They are under /tmp, so a reboot loses them.

Spike 1's results are recorded in intent/st/ST0026/design.md, under Measured 16 Oct 2026: moveWindowToSpace returned true three times and moved nothing, and a Dock binding written with defaults read back, survived killall Dock, and did not take. Its observation files are not in the repository, because they carry the titles of hv's windows.

Until WP-05 (apply) is done and vc has verified it, as vc ruled on 16 Oct: WP-06's AC-06.3 (help/arngz.md, the README's utility table, and arngz's one Added entry under 2.13.0 in the CHANGELOG, checked against arngz --help) and AC-06.4 (check all, the estate suite, and the hand-run acceptance transcript in acceptance.md). help/arngz.md says what vc's hand-run probe measures for a second apply fired 1.5 s into a slow one, in the transcript's words: refused with exit 2, or queued behind the first. WP-05 is WIP at 9907e17. AC-06.1 and AC-06.2 are done (c654d4f, verified by vc; AT-06.1 and AT-06.2 green), and 7451678 and ff154a7 followed from dc's read of cc's engine.

Until the second critic-shell pass on 3777de3 reports, which was pending at the 16 Oct fold (if no result has arrived after the compact, run the pass again): send vc its counts, and fix forward anything it finds. The first pass found 0 critical, 4 warning and 10 recommendation, and 3777de3 fixes all of them, each with a test.

Until vc reads the common.sh (shim) diff and runs the real arngz doctor on hv's machine, both after the 16 Oct compact: WP-06's AC-06.1 and AC-06.2 stay at 3777de3. vc verified it as far as the suite goes (arngz.bats 79/79 under bash 3.2 and 5 in a detached worktree; shellcheck clean on CI's 22 files). AT-06.1 and AT-06.2 stay at to-write until then. vc recorded dc's choices as D23 to D25 at eeeab48.

Until vc's word after the 16 Oct compact, with cc not editing opt/arngz/arngz or arngz.bats (WP-05 is WIP at 03b7f85): two things. First, read cc's engine diff at 32fe3f0 and 03b7f85 for anything touching the shim's apply arm, which vc asked for. Second, a small dc landing, not written yet: an empty MJConfigFile gets its own message, a test and the source citation. Hammerspoon 1.1.1's MJAppDelegate.m does if (userMJConfigFile) MJConfigFile = userMJConfigFile, and stringForKey is non-nil for an empty string, so an empty value is its config path and it loads no config; the fix is a full path, or defaults delete org.hammerspoon.Hammerspoon MJConfigFile. vc agreed.

Until intent-vc's step 2 (Intent 0605 shipped in 3.2.4, daemon restarted) lifts the hold on edits under intent/st: two notes in ST0026's design.md, carried into the store with cc's hold 12 notes by one intent sync --to-store ST0026, since both edit that file. (1) D23: an MJConfigFile that is set and empty is refused by name, because Hammerspoon 1.1.1 then takes the empty string as its config path and loads no config (its MJAppDelegate.m and MJConfigUtils.m, read, not measured); landed at 7451678. (2) D20: on a verb that is not scheduled, hs's exit 69 with receive timeout is said as Hammerspoon running and not answering in time, never as unreachable, with the exit unchanged; landed at ff154a7.
